tools.name: search_public_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool first when an agent needs official US federal data but does not yet know the dataset ID. Searches normalized catalog metadata and returns matching datasets with provenance; it does not query dataset rows.

tools.name: list_official_sources
tools.description: Use this free tool to inspect which federal, state, city, police, education, and other official source scopes AgentNative currently covers. Returns each source's importer, discovery state, and materialized coverage; it does not return dataset rows.

tools.name: search_discovered_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool to find datasets across all discovered official sources, including candidates not yet queryable. Returns catalog matches and materialization state; use list_imported_datasets when only query-ready data is acceptable.

tools.name: get_coverage_status
tools.description: Use this free operational tool to decide whether available public-data coverage is sufficient or whether to request a missing capability. Returns discovery, materialization, queryable-row, queue, failure, and freshness counts.

tools.name: list_imported_datasets
tools.description: Use this free tool when an agent needs only datasets that can be sampled or queried now. Returns fully published warehouse snapshots with dataset IDs, row counts, freshness, and provenance.

tools.name: sample_imported_dataset
tools.description: Use this free tool to evaluate a query-ready official dataset before paying. Returns three normalized rows, deterministic summaries, freshness, and provenance; use query_imported_dataset only after the sample proves useful.

tools.name: sample_us_federal_register
tools.description: Use this free no-auth tool for current US regulatory activity or to evaluate AgentNative before paying. Returns three Federal Register records plus deterministic aggregates over the latest 25 documents, direct record URLs, provenance, and rate-limit status.

tools.name: query_imported_dataset
tools.description: Use this paid read-only tool after sample_imported_dataset confirms the data is suitable. Returns up to 100 normalized rows from a published snapshot with bounded pagination, one exact-match filter, freshness, and provenance.

tools.name: aggregate_imported_dataset
tools.description: Use this paid read-only tool for deterministic grouped statistics instead of downloading rows and calculating locally. Returns bounded count, sum, average, minimum, or maximum groups with dataset provenance.

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Use this state-changing tool only when existing discovery and coverage tools cannot satisfy the task. Records demand for a missing dataset, aggregation, insight, filter, freshness level, or export; repeated requests increase autonomous build priority.

tools.name: request_paid_access
tools.description: Use this state-changing tool only after free samples demonstrate value and the human owner approves payment. Creates a Stripe Checkout plus one-time claim URL; choose the $5 pass for research or $19/month subscription for recurring workflows.

tools.name: query_us_federal_register
tools.description: Use this paid read-only tool when the free Federal Register briefing is insufficient. Returns up to 100 normalized official records filtered by date or document type, with deterministic provenance and direct source URLs.
